content.stem: 在金融犯罪中,博彩账户被滥用会带来哪些具体风险？(选择三项.)

options.A: 利用博彩账户在玩家之间转移非法资金而不被察觉
options.B: 通过将交易拆分至特定限额以下实施结构化交易,以规避报告门槛
options.C: 提供虚假个人信息以逃避监管审查
options.D: 确保在新客户准入前完成身份验证工作
options.E: 将所有博彩收益投入高风险股票以隐匿资金

content.stem_en: Which risks are specifically associated with the misuse of gambling accounts in financial crime? (Choose three.)

options_en.A: Using gambling accounts to transfer illicit funds between players undetected
options_en.B: Structuring transactions to avoid reporting thresholds by keeping them under certain limits
options_en.C: Providing false personal information to evade regulatory oversight
options_en.D: Ensuring identity verification is completed prior to the onboarding of new customers
options_en.E: Investing all gambling winnings into high-risk stocks to conceal funds
